question: What was the name of the spacecraft by which Rakesh Sharma traveled to space?A. Soyuz T-11B. Rockwell X-30C. Spiral-EPOSD. Mercury-Atlas 9 (RRB NTPC Tier I (28/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: A
B
C
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Soyuz T-11

Explanation:
Rakesh Sharma, the first Indian astronaut, traveled to space in the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz T-11 in 1984. The mission, launched on April 2, 1984, was part of the Intercosmos programme. He spent 7 days, 21 hours, and 40 minutes aboard the Salyut-7 space station. The crew included Rakesh Sharma, Yuri Malyshev, and Gennady Strekalov. During his stay, he conducted experiments and famously spoke with Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, saying he saw India from space as "Sare Jahan se Achha."

question: Where is the Central Potato Research Institute of India located? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 1)
options: Ranchi
Lucknow
Shimla
Delhi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Shimla

Explanation:
India's Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI) is located in Shimla. Established in 1949, it functions under the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR). Its primary objectives include developing high-yielding potato varieties, improving production technologies, and managing diseases. CPRI has released over 60 potato varieties suitable for different agro-climatic regions. The institute also has regional research stations in Patna, Jalandhar, Modipuram, and other locations. CPRI plays a key role in India's potato production, which is the third largest in the world.

question: The National Rural Health Mission was launched in the year: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: 2007
2005
2002
2012
solution:

Explanation:
The National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) was launched by the Government of India on 12 April 2005 under the leadership of then Prime Minister Manmohan Singh. question: National Handloom day is celebrated every year on ________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 2)
